verdict.rationale: Google Drive is a SaaS storage service, so an official MCP server is a fair thing to ask for, but nothing in the evidence documents one. The REST API, push notifications and the ADK/Vertex AI agent add-on guidance are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not an official MCP server an agent can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
